bullets.text: Ofcom's 6 GHz Spectrum Split - Ofcom proposes a split-priority approach for mobile and Wi-Fi services in the 6 GHz band.
Vodafone's Ad Campaign Banned - ASA bans Vodafone's 'Nation's Network' ads for misleading claims about network superiority.
BT Sells US Federal Unit - BT divests its US government contracting operation to focus on core UK services.
Cyberattack Costs Soar - Average recovery costs from cyberattacks hit $2.5 million as downtime increases.
AI's Role in Telecom Networks - AI and ML are becoming essential for managing complex service provider networks.
6G Networks to Automate Workflows - Future 6G networks will host AI agents to streamline enterprise processes.
FCC Votes on 6 GHz Devices - FCC to create new high-power device category for enhanced Wi-Fi and IoT capabilities.
SoftBank's AI Infrastructure Bet - SoftBank's acquisition of DigitalBridge highlights AI's impact on telecom infrastructure.
